description: This custom Power BI visual specializes in generating clear, intuitive seasonality charts that display historical ranges and patterns in your time-series data. Perfect for analyzing recurring patterns across years, this visual shows: * **Historical Ranges:** Instantly view minimum and maximum boundaries for each time period (day/week/month). * **Central Tendency:** Track average values against historical ranges to identify typical seasonal behavior. * **Current Performance:** Compare current period values against historical patterns to spot anomalies. **Key Features:** * Automatic calculation of seasonal min/max/average bands * Flexible time aggregation (daily, weekly, monthly views) * Customizable colors and formatting options **Ideal Applications:** * Sales performance analysis * Weather pattern studies * Energy consumption tracking * Retail inventory planning * Tourism seasonal trends * Agricultural yield analysis This visual helps business analysts, data scientists, and decision-makers quickly understand historical patterns and identify when current performance deviates from expected seasonal ranges, all without complex statistical setup.
